reason: At my counter during breakfast rush nobody is pulling out a phone to show a coupon for a ₹40 masala dosa, and I am not stopping to type PINs. The count will come out near zero, so the WhatsApp report will tell me nothing I can trust.
objection: Customers won't bother showing a coupon, so the number will undercount and I still won't know if the creator brought anyone.
would_change_my_mind: Another darshini or café owner nearby showing me that their customers actually showed the coupon and the evening counts matched their bill book.
